title: Preping：无需任务即可构建智能体记忆
summary: Preping提出了一种无需任务经验即可构建智能体程序性记忆的方法，通过提议者引导的合成实践、执行和验证框架，在AppWorld等基准上性能与基于剧本的方法相当，且部署成本降低2-3倍。
summary_en: Preping proposes a proposer-guided framework for building agent procedural memory without task-specific experience, using synthetic practice, execution, and validation. It achieves competitive performance with playbook-based methods on AppWorld, BFCL v3, and MCP-Universe, with 2-3x lower deployment cost.
